html.description: Plain HTML/Handlebars to preview, using {{variable}} placeholders. Do NOT base64-encode it. The markup must be self-contained: reference images, fonts and scripts by public https URL, or inline small ones as data: URIs. A local or relative path (./logo.png, /home/..., file://...) renders blank — nothing that renders this HTML can read your filesystem. Prefer https URLs over inlining here: the whole draft is compressed into the link, and a data: URI does not compress, so an inlined asset costs its full size in the URL while text-heavy markup costs about a quarter of it.

variables.description: Modify Payload: values to fill the placeholders for this preview render.

html.description: Plain HTML/Handlebars for the template, using {{variable}} placeholders. Do NOT base64-encode it. The markup must be self-contained: reference images, fonts and scripts by public https URL, or inline small ones as data: URIs. A local or relative path (./logo.png, /home/..., file://...) renders blank — nothing that renders this HTML can read your filesystem.

variables.description: Template Variables: the default values/shape for the template placeholders (the schema, not per-render data).

html.description: Plain HTML (with inline CSS) to render into an image. Do NOT base64-encode it. The markup must be self-contained: reference images, fonts and scripts by public https URL, or inline small ones as data: URIs. A local or relative path (./logo.png, /home/..., file://...) renders blank — nothing that renders this HTML can read your filesystem.

transparentBackground.description: Render with a transparent background instead of white.

inspect.description: When true, also return a small downscaled preview image of the result so you can see it and iterate.

templateId.description: Id of an existing oJo template (from list_templates).

modify.description: Modify Payload: per-render values that override the template variable defaults (merged over the defaults).
